newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine oil firm YPF says in deal with U.S Amoco.
newsitem.headline: Argentine oil firm YPF says in deal with U.S Amoco.

text.p: Argentine oil firm YPF SA said Thursday Maxus Energy Corp, its international operating subsidiary, has reached an agreement in principle with U.S. firm Amoco to form a joint venture in the United States.

"It is anticipated that Midgard Energy Company, a subsidiary of Maxus, and Amoco will each contribute to the joint venture oil and gas properties and related assets located in the Texas Panhandle and in Western Oklahoma and that Amoco will contribute certain assets," YPF said.
YPF said it expects the joint-venture to become effective early next year pending the approval of each firm's board of directors.
It said the two companies have agreed to release no further information on the deal until a definitive accord is signed.
